2. The corpus is about the subject and never states the fact
Q: When did the streaming aggregator start dropping frames?

coverage: 50%

3. Evidence disagrees with itself
Q: How many times does the provider gateway retry?
baseline (similarity 60% >= 50%): SEND
AnswerabilityKit: BLOCKED contested - disputed: times provider gateway retry
coverage: 100% ← plenty of evidence. that is why a coverage score cannot see it

coverage: n/a ← no rate is reported for work that was never done
